thread:
Elaine (AE): quick heads-up — NovaHealth wants the final load plan and answers to the security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. they expect a 95th pct latency < 200ms at 500 qps for chat-infer. can we confirm test approach?
Sam (SRE): copying previous POC template + a small change: we'll run two phases — smoke (50 qps) then soak (500 qps sustained for 30m). want to validate tail latency and p99 CPU/GPU. plan to use k6 distributed across 3 clients.
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): for the chat model mix we'll mirror production: 60% short prompts (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (65-256), 10% long (>256). that affects batching and KV cache hits. i'll prepare a load profile and include sequence length distribution.
Elaine (AE): thanks. can you also put an estimated cost for Hosted vs Dedicated for the soak run so sales can include it in the quote? NovaHealth asked about burst pricing too.
Sam (SRE): rough calc: hosted burn for 30m @ 500 qps with avg 60 tokens per request ~= X token-units (i'll detail). Dedicated estimate depends on pool size — will propose two configs (baseline and 2x burst).
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): test infra note — we need an API key with rate-limit disabled for the test clients (temp). @DeployBot can you provision a test-api key with tag nova-poc and expiry 72h?
DeployBot: API key nova-poc-202603 provided. expires in 72h. scope: inference:generate, embeddings:read.
Rebecca (Security): quick flag from the questionnaire: they want KMS integration and audit log export. NovaHealth requires proof of envelope encryption + key rotation policy. do we have documentation?
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): yes — we have a KMS integration doc and a sample key rotation schedule. attaching link: https://internal.docs/redwood/kms-integration (will include in the deliverable).
Elaine (AE): also confirm network requirements — they asked about private VPC peering for Private deployment tests. is that a blocker for the soak?
Sam (SRE): private peering will add ~48h ops lead time. for the soak tomorrow we should run over public endpoints with encrypted transport and IP allowlist. if Nova insists on peering we push soak out.
Elaine (AE): i'll ask them to accept the public-run smoke and postpone peering-dependent soak.
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): load test commands for SRE:
```
# k6 script invocation (distributed)
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 30m --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 nova_chat_test.js
# sample request payload
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-1-chat-medium",
  "input": "<prompt>",
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
Sam (SRE): perfect. i'll push the k6 script and Grafana dashboard link. capturing metrics: latency histograms, p50/p95/p99, GPU util, L7 errors, retries.
Elaine (AE): pricing question from legal/purchasing: if they need a short-term Dedicated for POC (2 weeks) is there a minimum commit?
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): Dedicated requires a monthly commit, but for POCs we offer a short-term eval addendum (engineering approval). i'll ask infra to draft a one-off paperwork.
Rebecca (Security): also need to confirm our data retention setting during the POC — they want logs retained for 90 days, can we support on Hosted?
Sam (SRE): hosted default retention is 30d. we can offer 90d as an add-on (extra cost). i'll include cost delta in the doc.
Elaine (AE): OK — action items: @Mohammed produce load profile + sequence distribution + Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta; @Sam prepare k6 script, dashboard, and perf targets doc; @Rebecca produce KMS + retention answers and signoff statement; i'll coordinate with NovaHealth to accept smoke on public endpoints and confirm peering timeline. aiming for deliverable by EOD tomorrow.
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): putting estimates now — sending a short writeup in the thread after i run a quick sample.
Sam (SRE): starting smoke now (50 qps) — will post preliminary latencies in ~10m.
DeployBot: smoke run started at 3440015000, run-id=smoke-nova-001. metrics streaming to grafana/d/POC/nova.
Sam (SRE): smoke results (10m): p50 45ms, p95 160ms, p99 380ms, error rate 0.2% (retries 0.1%). upload: https://grafana.internal/d/POC/nova?panelId=6
Elaine (AE): thanks — p95 looks within target but p99 is high. can we reduce p99 for soak?
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): p99 is likely due to a small % of long prompts and occasional KV cache miss. for soak we can enable prefix caching and adjust batch window from 10ms -> 5ms to reduce latency jitter (tradeoff: lower throughput efficiency). i'll note tradeoffs in the writeup.
Sam (SRE): agree. also tune GPU prefetch and async io; i'll schedule a parameter sweep before soak.
Rebecca (Security): all security docs attached to the ticket; i'll sign off once KMS + retention wording is included.
Elaine (AE): great. i'll send an updated SOW and the questionnaire answers to NovaHealth. thanks team :thumbsup:
Mohammed (Solutions Eng): uploading the detailed loadplan + cost delta now.
Sam (SRE): will report soak run in this thread once complete.
Elaine (AE): last_message — thanks everyone, keeping this thread as the single source for POC handoff.
